integrity: The criterion is derived directly from the three printed Rota-Baxter identities, without relying on the source proof. A symbolic checker reconstructs the general scalar defect and independently instantiates the two-dimensional example.
scientific_limitations: The result gives a scalar-operator criterion and corrects one displayed example; it is not a classification of all Rota-Baxter operators on BiHom-associative trialgebras.
If the source intended its example only at weight zero, the displayed map becomes the trivial zero operator; the inspected example states no such restriction.
A later unindexed correction may exist.
title: Scalar Rota–Baxter operators force the two side products to coincide
